title: The calendar allocates attention
governingQuestion: How does one schedule distribute time, visibility and permission across a city?
rightsBoundary: Protected invitations, films, backstage photography and organizer interfaces remain authorized-embed, link-only, or permission candidates. No reproduction right is inferred from public access.

beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Copenhagen turns participation into an evidence problem: admission, time, teardown, rights, screening, product data and institutional memory each demand a record. This chapter follows staging: Atmosphere is engineered through temporary architecture, power, light, sound, seating, cueing, safety and teardown—then edited out of the effortless final image.
beats.onScreen: Then: The official programme distinguishes exclusive show and presentation slots from events and talks that may overlap.
beats.credit: Scandinavian Academy of Fashion Design · CC BY-SA 4.0

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The official programme distinguishes exclusive show and presentation slots from events and talks that may overlap. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: Event profiles can identify invitation-only or public access and publish RSVP details, making the schedule an access interface as well as a calendar.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: No reviewed public source exposes one universal credential, guest-list, security or accessibility stack for every CPHFW venue.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger
